answer.reason: Pennsylvania's restructuring leaves only a very small amount of generation under electric utilities, while independent power producers and combined heat and power (IPP & CHP) account for the large majority of the state's net generation. The Table 1 listing for IPP & CHP is therefore 241,386,154 megawatthours.
